name: 68522 · Lincoln, NE
findings: ZIP 68522 (Lincoln) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68522 (Lincoln) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
